form: MLP_8(x) + SiLU(x . gate) * (x . up) * down, where x is layer 8's MLP input (the post-attention RMSNorm output)

training.data: Sauers/Qwen3-8B-tawny-owl-128-neurons-data (train.jsonl, 2,695 chats; 274 held out for validation by prompt)
training.optimizer: AdamW (betas 0.9, 0.99, no weight decay), 20-step warmup, cosine decay
training.init: gate and up ~ N(0, 0.02^2), down = 0 (an exact no-op at the start); seed 0
training.loss: cross-entropy on the final assistant reply only; thinking off except for the 314 chats that carry a reasoning trace
training.frozen: every original Qwen3-8B weight (bf16); only the 12,288 numbers above were trained (fp32)
